findings.title: Fourteen EN descriptions contain lookalike Unicode rejected by the development Translator guard

anchors.evidence: U+2014/U+2212 are forbidden; EN non-Mod files throw in Core.IS_DEV.

findings.reproduction_evidence: Exact value scan against current guard finds 14 affected descriptions; codepoints are recorded per row.
findings.missing_proof: No development game launch; exact guard/throw path is static evidence.
findings.recommended_correction: Replace forbidden characters with loader-approved punctuation without changing meaning.
findings.smallest_regression_test: Load real EN UI.json through the development guard and assert no lookalike exception.
